csv_scope_of_work: The Stanley Housing Authority is requesting Architectural and Engineering bids for a paving and concrete project at Sunset Homes in Stanley, WI. The project includes replacement and redesign of the west visitors parking lot to include curb and gutter and addition of stairs and a ramp, chip sealing a private road around the property, seal coating the main parking lot, replacing or repairing broken/uneven concrete as needed, ensuring the correct grade and adding rails as needed and the possible addition of sidewalks on the back side of the units on the east side of the property.
